subject: Vendor portal provisioning schedule & evidence gap list
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orchard-systems.com>, Procurement <procurement@orchard-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portal provisioning schedule & evidence gap list

Hi Elena / Orchard procurement team,

Thanks for moving this forward — we’re ready to provision our Vendr/Whistic profiles and wanted to align on logistics and an initial evidence gap list so the onboarding window is productive. High-level ask: can Orchard open the portal invite for Redwood and share the primary SSO contact (Okta/SCIM person) so we can configure SSO before evidence uploads?

What we can provide immediately:
- SOC 2 summary report + system description (I’ll attach a short snapshot)
- Compact CAIQ -> SIG mapping we maintain for quick handoff

Proposed onboarding windows (PDT):
- Tue June 23, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed June 24, 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Orchard needs a PO before we accept the portal invitation? I’ve attached a provisioning checklist so we don’t miss anything.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: portal-provisioning-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orchard-systems.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orchard-systems.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning schedule & evidence gap list

Markus — thanks for the clear note. We can do Tue June 23 at 14:00 PDT for a 45 minute provisioning call; that works best for our security and SSO folks. A few quick items from our side:

- We use Okta for SSO; SCIM provisioning ownership sits with our Identity team (cc’d: identity@orchard-systems.com). Please let us know the redirect/callback URL for configuring the app.
- For evidence: a SOC 2 snapshot and a CAIQ/Cloud SIG crosswalk are ideal. If you can provide a small matrix that shows where evidence lives (S3 or shared drive links) that speeds review.
- Procurement: Orchard generally issues PO after portal access is validated. Procurement, can we hold a $0 placeholder PO to allow provisioning?

Attaching our contacts file for onboarding coordination.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Security Program Manager
Orchard Systems
[Attachment: orchard-org-contacts.csv (CSV)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning schedule & evidence gap list

Looping internal owners and sketching a playbook for the Tue provisioning slot (14:00 PDT). Action items:

- Rishi: upload SOC 2 snapshot and system description to Vendr / provide shareable links (target: Mon EOD).
- Ben: prepare Okta app metadata (redirect URLs, entity ID, certs) and be on the call to confirm SCIM scope.
- Monica: assemble initial SIG/CAIQ compact matrix (what we can surface in portal) and highlight the 3 high-touch artifacts Orchard typically asks for (KMS doc, dataflow diagram, retention policy).

I’ve attached a working evidence matrix with our initial gap flags. Monica — please add the red/amber/green flags next to items you expect will require follow-up. We should also prepare a short screen-share doc for the provisioning call showing where each artifact lives (S3 path / Drive link).

Notes: Orchard requested a quick CAIQ -> SIG mapping; I’ll include that in the upload as a compact CSV so the reviewer can map quickly.

Rishi
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sig-evidence-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orchard-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@orchard-systems.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning schedule & evidence gap list

Elena — appreciate the confirmation. Attaching the SOC 2 snapshot and a compact CAIQ->SIG mapping for Orchard’s intake.

Practical notes for the call (Tue 14:00 PDT):
- We’ll join from redwood-inference@redwood.ai; please send the Vendr/Whistic invite to that address.
- Ben will validate the Okta metadata live; please have your Identity engineer available.
- We’ll demonstrate where artifacts live (Drive links in the chat) and mark items we can mark as ‘evidence provided’ vs items requiring a follow-up ticket.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary-2026-06.pdf, redwood-caiq-mapping-compact.csv

If Orchard prefers we upload the full CAIQ instead of a compact mapping, say the word and Monica will push the full spreadsheet to the portal.

Thanks — see you on the call.

-Markus
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2026-06.pdf (PDF), redwood-caiq-mapping-compact.csv (CSV)]

Date: 2026-06-24T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning schedule & evidence gap list

Markus / team — quick update from Orchard after the provisioning call:

- Identity team confirmed Okta config and we received the SAML metadata during the call. Ben, thanks for walking through the cert rotation plan.
- Security review: the SOC 2 snapshot and CAIQ compact mapping are sufficient to provision an initial profile. We’ve marked a few items as "additional evidence requested" in Vendr (KMS key rotation logs, sample retention configuration).
- Procurement: we will issue the PO once access is confirmed (Procurement team to follow up on next steps).

We’ve sent a portal invite to redwood-inference@redwood.ai — please accept and start the upload. I’ll ping when procurement has the PO number.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Security Program Manager
Orchard Systems
